B0DHYJKVX9.title: Tapo Smart Dimmer Switch, Single Pole, Need Neutral Wire, S500D(4-Pack)
bullets: Single-Pole Dimmer Light Switch: Replace a compatible single-pole wall switch to adjust lighting for reading, meals or relaxing. This is not a wired 3-way dimmer. Package includes 4 S500D switches.

Dimming for Compatible LED Lights: Set brightness with the wall controls, Tapo app or supported voice commands. Leading-edge TRIAC dimming supports up to 150W dimmable LED or 300W incandescent/halogen lighting at 120V, 60Hz. Check the bulb manufacturer’s dimming compatibility.
App and Voice Control: Control lighting through the Tapo app, Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant. No hub is required for standard Tapo app control over Wi-Fi.
Schedules and Timers: Set routines or countdown timers for connected lighting. Away Mode can turn lights on and off at intervals to simulate occupancy.
Fade On and Off: Use smooth brightness transitions for everyday lighting. Adjust light levels for activities such as watching a movie, reading or winding down.

App-Guided Installation: Neutral wire, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and a suitable wall box at least 2 inches deep are required. Follow the Tapo app and supplied installation guide. Consult an electrician if unfamiliar with electrical wiring. Indoor, dry-location use only.

Tapo Automation Options: Standard Wi-Fi control requires no hub. Optional automation with compatible Tapo sensors or smart buttons requires a Tapo hub and separately sold accessories. The switch itself remains a single-pole device and does not support wired 3-way installation.
